title: 第171章 接触心脏数据洪流冲击第170章 夺取模式十二样本
lines: 星海诊疗中心的庆祝气氛只持续了不到一天。
在成功化解数据瘟疫的第四十八小时，埃塔的高维探测器捕捉到了一个异常信号，不是攻击，不是病毒，而是一种……“邀请”。
“信号来自维度夹缝，坐标无法锁定，但传递方式使用了议会最高级别的加密协议。”埃塔将解析后的信息投影在会议室中央，“内容是：请求与‘平衡医官’对话。落款：第七医疗委员会观察员西格玛。”
“西格玛……”林澈回忆着械神界日志中的记录，“那个签署了械神界实验记录的高级观察员。他亲自来了？”
“不是本体，”埃塔分析信号结构，“是远程投影。他在维度夹缝中创造了一个临时的‘中立区’，邀请你前往。按照议会协议，中立区禁止任何形式的攻击，是用于文明评估的标准程序。”
老院长眉头紧锁：“可能是陷阱。议会刚刚攻击失败，现在就来‘对话’，太可疑了。”
“但这也是机会，”白雨说，“我们一直缺少对议会内部情况的了解。如果能在不交战的情况下获取信息……”
赵虎的机械右臂闪烁着警惕的光芒：“先生，我跟你一起去。如果出事，至少我能挡一下。”
林澈沉思良久。手术刀在他手中温润地发光，刀身上的平衡模型缓慢旋转，似乎在分析各种可能性。
“我一个人去，”他最终决定，“这是医官之间的对话。你们留在外部，监控所有维度参数。如果发现异常……不要犹豫，立刻切断连接，不必管我。”
“林澈！”老院长想反对。
“必须去，”林澈坚定地说，“我们需要知道议会真正的目的。是为了毁灭？还是为了某种我们不知道的‘治疗’？械神界的日志显示，他们自称‘医疗委员会’。也许……他们真的认为自己在做正确的事。”
他看向埃塔：“建立连接吧。但做好随时中断的准备。”
埃塔点头，开始操作高维设备。一道稳定的空间门在会议室中央缓缓展开，门后是一片纯粹的灰色，没有物质能量，只有虚无。
林澈深吸一口气，握紧手术刀，踏入其中。
穿过门的瞬间，他感觉自己被“剥离”了。
不是物理上的剥离，是存在层面的简化。他的血肉、骨骼、灵力、记忆，一切都被暂时转化为最基础的信息结构，然后在门的另一侧重新组合。
重组完成后，他发现自己站在一个纯白色的圆形平台上。平台悬浮在无尽的灰色虚空中，直径大约十米，除了中央一张白色桌子两把白色椅子外，空无一物。
桌子对面，已经坐着一个人形存在。
它有着人类的轮廓，但身体由流动的、半透明的数据构成，面部没有五官，只有一个不断变化的几何图案，那是议会高级成员的视觉标识。
“医官林澈，”存在开口，声音是中性的，没有情绪起伏，但也不冰冷，“我是西格玛。感谢接受邀请。”
林澈在对面的椅子坐下，手术刀平放在腿上：“你想谈什么？”
“谈‘治疗’，”西格玛的几何面图案稳定成一个等边三角形——这是议会表示“正式对话开始”的符号，“你们抵抗秩序病毒的方式，超出了所有预测模型。你们没有摧毁病毒，而是吸收了它，让它成为系统的一部分。这种做法……有记录以来第一次出现。”
“所以你们想学习？”林澈问。
“想理解，”西格玛纠正，“议会第七医疗委员会的存在意义，是研究和治疗低维世界的‘病变’。我们观测过无数文明，记录过无数种疾病和治疗方法。但你们展现的‘平衡疗法’……不在任何已知分类中。”
林澈注意到对方的用词：“你说‘治疗’？但械神界的记录显示，你们在故意制造病变，进行极限测试。”
西格玛的几何面变成了一个问号：“那是必要的研究方法。要理解疾病，必须先制造疾病。要测试治疗方案，必须让病情发展到足够严重的程度。这是医学研究的基础逻辑。”
“用亿万生命做实验？”林澈的声音冷了下来。
“生命是相对的，”西格玛平静地说，“从高维视角，低维生命的存在如同细胞。在研究器官病变时，牺牲部分细胞是必要的代价。”
“所以你们认为自己是‘医生’，而我们是‘细胞’？”林澈握紧了手术刀。
“这是事实，不是观点，”西格玛的几何面恢复成三角形，“但你们最近的表现，让委员会开始重新评估。细胞通常不会发展出免疫系统，更不会吸收病原体来自我强化。你们展现出了……‘器官级别’的潜力。”
林澈突然明白了：“你们不是要毁灭我们，是……在筛选？”
“正确，”西格玛点头——虽然他没有头，但数据体做出了相应的姿态，“议会对低维世界的干预分为三个阶段：观察、测试、评估。观察期记录自然病变。测试期施加压力，观察反应。评估期根据反应，决定最终处理方式。”
“处理方式有哪些？”
“三种，”西格玛列举，“第一，判定为‘无价值样本’，直接归档销毁，这是大多数世界的结局。第二，判定为‘有价值病变样本’，保留在实验库中，供进一步研究，械神界原本是这个分类。第三，判定为‘潜在治疗者’，给予观察和培养资格。”
他顿了顿：“你们正在从第二类向第三类转变。这是一个极其罕见的过程。在过去的一百个纪元中，只有七个世界完成过这种转变。”
林澈的心脏猛地一跳：“那些世界……后来怎么样了？”
西格玛的几何面变成了一个旋转的立方体：“三个在后续测试中失败，回归第二类。两个晋升为‘初级治疗助手’，协助议会管理其他世界。一个……叛逃了。”
“叛逃？”
“那个世界的医官，偷走了议会部分核心数据，制造了一批‘干预工具’，投放到其他世界，”西格玛看向林澈手中的手术刀，“就像你手里的那把。”
content_en:
The celebratory atmosphere at Xinghai Medical Center lasted less than a day.
On the 48th hour after successfully resolving the data plague, ETA's high-dimensional detector captured an abnormal signal. It was not an attack, not a virus, but an... "invitation."
"The signal comes from the dimensional gap, and the coordinates cannot be locked, but the transmission method uses the highest level encryption protocol of the Parliament." Etta projected the parsed information in the center of the conference room. "The content is: Request to talk to the 'Balance Medical Officer'. Signed: Sigma, Observer of the Seventh Medical Committee."
"Sigma..." Lin Che recalled the records in the Mechanical God Realm's log, "The senior observer who signed the Mechanical God Realm's experimental records. Did he come in person?"
"It's not the body," Etta analyzed the signal structure, "it's a remote projection. He created a temporary 'neutral zone' in the dimensional gap and invites you to go. According to the parliamentary agreement, the neutral zone prohibits any form of attack and is a standard procedure for civilization assessment."
The old dean frowned: "It may be a trap. The parliament just failed to attack, and now they are having a 'dialogue'. It's too suspicious."
"But this is also an opportunity," Bai Yu said. "We have always lacked understanding of the internal situation of the parliament. If we can obtain information without going to war..."
Zhao Hu's mechanical right arm flashed with a vigilant light: "Sir, I will go with you. If something happens, at least I can block it."
Lin Che thought for a long time. The scalpel glowed warmly in his hand, and the balance model on the blade rotated slowly, as if analyzing various possibilities.
"I will go alone," he finally decided. "This is a conversation between medical officers. You stay outside and monitor all dimensional parameters. If any abnormalities are found...don't hesitate to cut off the connection immediately and leave me alone."
"Lin Che!" The old dean wanted to object.
"We must go," Lin Che said firmly. "We need to know the true purpose of the council. Is it for destruction? Or for some kind of 'treatment' that we don't know? The logs of the Mechanical God Realm show that they call themselves the 'Medical Committee.' Maybe... they really think they are doing the right thing."
He looked at Etta: "Establish the connection. But be prepared to interrupt at any time."
Etta nodded and began to operate the high-dimensional equipment. A stable space door slowly opened in the center of the conference room. Behind the door was pure gray, with no material energy, only nothingness.
Lin Che took a deep breath, held the scalpel tightly, and stepped into it.
The moment he walked through the door, he felt like he was being "stripped away".
It's not a physical separation, it's a simplification of the existential level. His flesh and blood, bones, spiritual power, memory, everything was temporarily transformed into the most basic information structure, and then reassembled on the other side of the door.
After the reorganization was complete, he found himself standing on a pure white circular platform. The platform is suspended in the endless gray void, about ten meters in diameter, and is empty except for a white table and two white chairs in the center.
Across the table, a humanoid being was already sitting.
It has human outlines, but the body is made of fluid, translucent data, and the face has no facial features, only an ever-changing geometric pattern that is the visual identity of senior members of the parliament.
"Medical Officer Lin Che," the existence spoke, his voice was neutral, without any emotional ups and downs, but not cold either, "I am Sigma. Thank you for accepting the invitation."
Lin Che sat down on the chair opposite, with the scalpel flat on her lap: "What do you want to talk about?"
"Talk about 'cure,'" the geometric facets of Sigma stabilized into an equilateral triangle—the Council's symbol for "the start of formal dialogue." "The way you resisted the virus of Order exceeded all predictive models. Instead of destroying the virus, you absorbed it and allowed it to become part of the system. This has happened... for the first time on record."
"So you want to learn?" Lin Che asked.
"I want to understand," Sigma corrected, "The purpose of the existence of the Seventh Medical Committee of the Parliament is to study and treat 'lesions' in the low-dimensional world. We have observed countless civilizations and recorded countless diseases and treatments. But the 'balance therapy' you showed... is not in any known classification."
Lin Che noticed the other party's wording: "You said 'treatment'? But the records of the Mechanical God Realm show that you are deliberately creating lesions and conducting extreme tests."
The geometric surface of Sigma turned into a question mark: "That is a necessary research method. To understand a disease, you must first create the disease. To test a treatment plan, the disease must develop to a serious enough level. This is the basic logic of medical research."
"Using billions of lives for experiments?" Lin Che's voice turned cold.
"Life is relative," Sigma said calmly. "From a high-dimensional perspective, low-dimensional life exists like cells. When studying organ diseases, sacrificing some cells is a necessary price."
"So you think you are 'doctors' and we are 'cells'?" Lin Che held the scalpel tightly.
"This is a fact, not an opinion." Sigma's geometric surface returned to a triangle, "But your recent performance has made the committee begin to re-evaluate. Cells usually do not develop an immune system, let alone absorb pathogens to strengthen themselves. You have shown... 'organ level' potential."
Lin Che suddenly understood: "You are not trying to destroy us, but... you are screening us?"
"Correct," Sigma nodded - although he had no head, the data body made a corresponding gesture. "The parliament's intervention in the low-dimensional world is divided into three stages: observation, testing, and evaluation. The observation period records natural lesions. The testing period applies pressure and observes the reaction. The evaluation period determines the final treatment method based on the reaction."
"What are the ways to deal with it?"
"Three types," Sigma listed. "First, they are judged as 'worthless samples' and are directly archived and destroyed. This is the outcome of most worlds. Second, they are judged as 'valuable disease samples' and retained in the experimental library for further research. This is the original classification of the Mechanical God World. Third, they are judged as 'potential healers' and are given qualifications for observation and training."
He paused: "You are transforming from the second category to the third category. This is an extremely rare process. In the past one hundred epochs, only seven worlds have completed this transformation."
Lin Che's heart skipped a beat: "What happened to those worlds?"
The geometric facets of Sigma turned into a rotating cube: "Three failed subsequent tests and returned to Category Two. Two were promoted to 'Junior Healing Assistants', assisting the Council in managing other worlds. One...defected."
"Defection?"
"The medical officer of that world stole some of the core data of the parliament, created a batch of 'intervention tools', and put them into other worlds." Sigma looked at the scalpel in Lin Che's hand, "just like the one in your hand."
